en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a lively public scene in front of a fortified, castle‑like building identified as the military club "Stella". People in early 20th‑century dress stroll and gather in an open square; horse‑drawn carriages are visible in the background. A flag with the Savoyard cross (Kingdom of Italy) flies atop the building. Printed caption text appears at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.
